title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall-b42 (SIBDH): on fresh seed 6 cells stay bounded (largest 8% of particles), the M and L layers pass, 13 persistent splits to generation 3, and death- and division-driven selection against the inert marker replicates; Supported
summary: The claim's world.py is byte-identical to the world of 20261025T1508-c14-pcell-mwall-b42-metabolic-claim, which I re-ran on fresh seed 6 (the claim used seeds 0-3); this review carries those runs (rerun/seed6: labkit, 100k steps; data/gen_s6.json.gz: the parent claim's genealogy.py; data/selection_s6.txt: its deathsel/birthfate/abslife) and adds the claim's bounded-size check (largest.py, data/largest_s6.txt). From noise, 24-31 round walled cells; after t=20000 the largest cell holds a median 8% of in-cell particles (max 15%, never above 30%; claim 7-8%, max 18%), median 29 cells. labkit: M wall material rim/core 4.1, rim/outside 20.6, 162/168 bodies membrane-like; L link layer rim/core 1.55, 124/168 (claim 3.87/3.91, 15.8/18.6; L 1.53/1.50); 13 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges (genealogy also 13, generation 3, 0 merges, 25 deaths). Selection: mature deaths at the 2nd yield percentile (12 deaths, all below the median) against the 60th for the identical-event inert marker; splits at the 86th against the 60th; 5/5 low-born cells die, 0/26 high-born do (marker 1/11, 4/20); mean yield 1.00 -> 1.10-1.13 while the marker stays at 0.98-1.00.

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the runs were made for my review of the metabolic extension (same world file) and are reused here; selection statistics rest on 12 mature deaths and 13 splits; M is passive (no feedback), so B is a self-made adsorbed layer; I used the authors' analysis scripts unchanged.
